name: rag-study-mvp
description: A study-focused custom RAG MVP using TypeScript, pgvector and Amazon Bedrock.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @rag-study/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @rag-study/web run dev
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @rag-study/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @rag-study/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @rag-study/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @rag-study/web run typecheck
